text: Thursday's project meeting. Five old notes.
What did we decide, and what's still open?
Before, you'd open each note, copy every item,
and compare them by hand. Easy to miss one.
Now you upload the same five notes to Example Notes AI.
It drafts a one-page prep brief:
decisions, open action items, and owners.
Like this one: vendor quote, no reply yet, owner Maya.
But it's a draft. Before you send it,
check each date and owner against the original notes.
If you run weekly meetings, try it on one old,
non-sensitive note first, and see what it misses.
